summary:
Validation of HEAD 3143629, the second attempt. Since the validated build f513faf, only three things changed: `.taad/fitness.yaml`, `eng/rules-harness/plants.json` and slice records (`git diff --stat`). Nothing under `src/` or `tests/` changed, so the real-desktop runs validate-1 made at f513faf still describe the shipped code.

**Criteria 1–11 are met.** I republished the exe (139,896,472 bytes) and re-ran B-007, C-001, S-002 and S-003 against it on this machine's desktop. All four exit 0 and print PASSED:
- stripRows is 1.
- OutcomeTabs keeps its height across the tab switch (187.17 → 187.165 px).
- The unselected list reads as off screen.

Core tests pass 381/381, rules-parity reports AGREE, and the Fitness check on the real tree says every rule holds.

**O-016 is fixed.** I ran the engine's own `taad3.fitness.check` on scratch copies of `MainWindow.xaml`:
- The HEAD pattern fires at line 107 on plant rows S09, S10, S11 and S12.
- It also fires on a `>` inside an attribute value, and on a DataGrid placed after comment, `ScrollViewer.Resources`, comment.
- It stays quiet on a self-closing ScrollViewer followed by a sibling list.

**O-017 (owed to build-slice) is real, and it breaks criterion 12.** The lazy `<!--.*?-->` in the HEAD pattern runs on to a later `-->` in the file, and it false-fires in three places:
- a comment placed first inside DriveScroller (fires at 114);
- a comment after OutcomeTexts' `</ScrollViewer.Style>` (fires at 289);
- the shape criterion 12 is about: a third TabItem with a commented caption ScrollViewer above a ListView in a star row (fires at 370).

So the next slice to add a section in the house style gets a false failing gate. The pattern O-017 proposes, run on the same copies, is quiet on all three and still fires on every must-fire shape, including a real ListView straight inside a ScrollViewer in a third tab (fires at 365).

**Not checked:** criteria 13 (keyboard) and 14 (DPI), both material:false.

**A loop.** Build attempt 2 changed config only, on this same regex. Code-review 2 then found that its own proposed pattern was defective. O-017 would make build attempt 3 config-only on the same line again. The cause is structural. `eng/rules-harness/harness.py` still exits 2 (CANNOT MEASURE: the clean baseline has an unran import rule). So every revision of the pattern is checked only by ad-hoc probes whose shapes are picked by whoever wrote it, and no quiet plant row pins the legitimate shapes. The O-017 fix should add quiet rows for both legitimate comment shapes and for the commented caption ScrollViewer in a third tab. The harness baseline also needs fixing, or the next lap looks the same.

All scratch folders are deleted, including the one the harness kept. No app or test host is left running, and the working tree is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: 1. show the outcome panel after a scan — no unreadable folders (N=0)
criteria.how: C-001 re-run at HEAD against the republished exe: EXIT 0, 17 ok, PASSED.

criteria.criterion: 2. show the outcome panel after a scan — at least 1 unreadable folder, default state at the 560x644 floor
criteria.how: B-007 re-run at HEAD passed (stripRows 1, off-screen reads for the unselected tab). S-001 and the real-folder runs come from validate-1 at f513faf, and src/ and tests/ are unchanged since (git diff).

criteria.criterion: 3. switch to the unreadable section — select UnreadableTab, then back to Largest files
criteria.how: S-002 re-run: EXIT 0, 70 ok. LargestFilesList keeps 98.12 px while off screen, and after going back LargestFilesTab is selected. B-007: the tabs are 187.17 px before and 187.165 px after.

criteria.criterion: 4. start a new scan — UnreadableTab selected when the scan starts, new result has N=0
criteria.how: S-003 re-run: EXIT 0, 26 ok. Before: selected=UnreadableTab, 136.88 px. After: UnreadableTab hidden and LargestFilesTab selected.

criteria.criterion: 5. choose the selected tab — Largest files hidden while Unreadable visible
criteria.how: S-004 passed in validate-1 at f513faf, with the hook's hide mode because the state cannot happen in the app. No src/ or tests/ change since. Not re-run at HEAD.

criteria.criterion: 6. show outcome text with no lists — no tab visible, long notes
criteria.how: S-005 passed in validate-1 at f513faf (texts 378.22 of 404.22 px, not capped). Unchanged src since. Not re-run.

criteria.criterion: 7. show outcome text above the tabs — long text wrapping at 560 while tabs visible
criteria.how: S-006 and B-008 passed in validate-1 at f513faf. B-007 re-run at HEAD passed. No src change.

criteria.criterion: 8. lay out the tab strip — 'Unreadable folders (12,345)' at MinWidth 560
criteria.how: S-007 (12,345 real denied folders) passed in validate-1 at f513faf with stripRows 1. B-007 at HEAD reports stripRows 1. No src change.

criteria.criterion: 9. list rows inside a tab — far more rows than fit, at 560x644 and maximized
criteria.how: S-008 passed in validate-1 at f513faf (171 ok). No src change. Not re-run at HEAD.
S-008 maximized passed in validate-1 at f513faf. No src change. Not re-run at HEAD.

criteria.criterion: 11. load results into a list — rescan replaces ItemsSource while its tab is unselected
criteria.how: S-009 passed in validate-1 at f513faf. No src change. Not re-run at HEAD.

criteria.criterion: 12. add a third section later — a third TabItem added by the next slice (material:false)
criteria.how: The design says this is 'enforced by the contract comment and the ScrollViewer rule'. The rule now catches violations: S09-S12 fire, and a ListView straight inside a ScrollViewer in a new third tab fires at 365. But at HEAD it also fires on legitimate XAML (O-017). With the engine's fitness.check, a third TabItem whose caption sits in a commented ScrollViewer above a ListView in a star row fires at 370. A comment inside DriveScroller fires at 114, and one after OutcomeTexts' ScrollViewer.Style fires at 289. The next slice that adds a section in the house style would get a false failing gate, and the easy way out of that is to weaken the rule. O-017's proposed pattern fixes all three and keeps every must-fire shape.

criteria.criterion: 13. switch tabs by keyboard — Ctrl+Tab / arrow keys (material:false)
criteria.how: No key input was sent to the window.
The machine is at 100%, and changing scaling is off-limits for this run.

criteria.criterion: build-check open item: outcome panel restructured to scroll or tab rather than per-section star rows and MinHeights
criteria.how: MainWindow.xaml:307-376: a single OutcomeTabs TabControl (MinHeight 154) with one TabItem per section. Runtime behaviour as in criteria 2-3 (B-007 and S-002 re-run at HEAD).

criteria.criterion: build-check open item: panel ready for largest folders / by-extension sections without breaking the fit
criteria.how: The layout half holds: validate-1's scratch four-tab build kept the fit, and a third TabItem needs no RowDefinition or MinHeight. The enforcement half does not: the gate the next slices will run false-fires on a legitimate commented section (line 370 in my probe) until O-017 lands.

obligations.evidence: .taad/fitness.yaml:810 now carries the review's pattern. Measured with taad3.fitness.check on scratch copies: S09, S10, S11 and S12 from plants.json each fire at 107. A '>' in an attribute fires, and so does a DataGrid after comment, Resources and comment. A self-closing ScrollViewer followed by a sibling list stays quiet. The clean tree is quiet.

Owed to build-slice and not done at HEAD 3143629. My own engine run (taad3.fitness.check on scratch copies) reproduces it. The HEAD pattern fires at 114 on a comment as DriveScroller's first child, at 289 on a comment after OutcomeTexts' </ScrollViewer.Style>, and at 370 on a legitimate third TabItem whose caption ScrollViewer holds a comment above a ListView in the star row. That last shape is criterion 12's own. O-017's tempered pattern, run on the same copies: quiet on all three and on the clean tree; fires on S09-S12, the '>' attribute case, comment+Resources+comment+DataGrid, and a ListView straight in a ScrollViewer inside a third tab (365); quiet on the self-closing sibling. Beyond O-017's one quiet plant row (the comment after </ScrollViewer.Style>), build-slice should add quiet rows for the DriveScroller comment and for the commented caption ScrollViewer in a new tab. Those are the shapes the next slices will actually write.

not_reached: The rule end to end through eng/rules-harness/harness.py (S09-S12, and any quiet row O-017 adds). It exits 2, CANNOT MEASURE, because the clean baseline has an unran import rule. Until build-slice fixes the baseline, every revision of this regex is checked only by ad-hoc probes. Two build/review laps on this one line (attempt 2, and O-017 about to cause attempt 3, both config-only) come from that gap.

S-001, S-004..S-009, B-008 and the real-folder runs (C:\Program Files, C:\ProgramData) were not repeated at 3143629. They rest on validate-1's real runs at f513faf, and src/ and tests/ are byte-unchanged since. At HEAD I re-ran only B-007, C-001, S-002 and S-003.
125% and 150% display scaling (criterion 14): the machine is at 100%, and changing scaling is off-limits.
Keyboard tab switching (criterion 13): no key input was sent to the window.
The real Largest folders and By extension sections. My third-TabItem shapes were written only for the rule probe and never rendered, and validate-1's four-header probe used empty ListBoxes.
A whole-drive (C:\) scan ending, where the 76 px text cap is said to scroll even when maximized.
The person-run network pass (N-001..N-004, StalledShareTests), made stale by this slice's MainWindow and hook changes. It is opt-in and was not run.
